sentence: This project tests an AI tool for digital pathology images that helps diagnose cancers and predict who benefits from chemotherapy and radiotherapy.
This project studies genes that repair DNA damage, aiming to use their defects to treat cancer.
This project uses AI to predict clinical outcomes of psychosis from electronic health records and genetic information.
This project studies how changes in the tissue around pancreatic tumors affect immune cells that fight the tumor during immunotherapy.
This project collects patient samples and clinical data, and tracks circulating tumor DNA over time to help detect early when the disease returns.
This project studies how changes in caregiver stress over time relate to caregiver and child interactions and to child language development.
This project covers Alzheimer’s Disease and other dementias, including Lewy body dementia and vascular dementia.
This project builds an AI model that predicts injury risk in adolescent athletes, and outcomes of rehabilitation and surgery, from movement data.
This project studies how gut microbial protein metabolism affects oral immunotherapy for peanut allergy.
This project tries to find out how kinetochores assemble and how errors in that process cause aneuploidy.
This project builds computer algorithms that combine neuroimaging and genetics data to study the clinical features of autism spectrum disorder.
This project studies how phthalate exposure during development changes brain signaling networks and raises the risk of neurodevelopmental disorders.
This project tests whether optical coherence tomography helps doctors diagnose ear infections in children more accurately.
This project provides laboratory services in immunology, genomics and virology to support HIV and AIDS research.
This project studies how the timing of synaptic development shapes cortical circuits and adult behavior.
This project tests whether fungi can enhance lung cancer by causing mutations or by changing immune responses.
This project studies how genes guide the early patterning of the embryo, including changes in cell shape, in amphibians.
This project studies how bacterial cholesterol-dependent cytolysins remodel host organelles to cause inflammasome activation.
This project studies the role of the extended amygdala in alcohol use disorder.
This project builds 3D biomaterial scaffolds that respond to focused ultrasound, so cell behavior can be genetically manipulated at set times and places.
